primary_hypothesis: count_likelihood has lower held-out probability MSE than unweighted soft labels after outcome-dependent 3-or-M sampling
cells: 2 noise levels x 2 budgets x 2 caps = 8
interval: paired two-sided Student t, Bonferroni across 8 primary contrasts
scope: iid Gaussian delay noise; 64-stage single Arbiter PUF; synthetic data
fixed_hyperparameters: probit link, L2=1e-6, L-BFGS-B 300 iterations, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-7
selection: no hyperparameter selection or validation queries; pilot did not change model settings
limitations: not an externally preregistered study; no claim of stronger binary attack or hardware validation; no world-priority proof
